items.title: Merrick Garland Supreme Court Blockade (2016)
items.summary: McConnell refused to hold hearings on President Obama's Supreme Court nominee Merrick Garland for 293 days in 2016, citing an election-year precedent. In 2020 he confirmed Justice Amy Coney Barrett 8 days before a presidential election, contradicting the stated rationale. McConnell publicly acknowledged the inconsistency.

items.title: INTC stock purchase before CHIPS Act vote (2021)
items.summary: McConnell purchased Intel (INTC) stock on July 15, 2021 — while serving on the Appropriations Committee and during active Senate negotiations on the CHIPS and Science Act, which would provide $52.7B in subsidies to U.S. semiconductor manufacturers including Intel. He voted Yea on the final bill in July 2022.
